## Purpose
`/forgot-password`: explains that there is no self-service reset. The steps are "Ask your platform administrator", then "Open the link they send you", and a note on "Locked after too many attempts?".

## Responsibilities
`ForgotPasswordPage` is static content in the `AuthParts` layout. Titled "Can't sign in — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`ForgotPasswordPage`.

## Interactions
It is a public path.

## Error handling and edge cases
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
Resets are admin-issued links (`/reset-password/$token`); no email is sent.
